description: Create the complete MQL5 Expert Advisor (ICT_Bot.mq5) that replicates all Python trading logic identically. The EA must produce the same entries, exits, and position sizing as the Python backtester when run on the same data in MT5 Strategy Tester.
steps: Create /projects/sandbox/ICT/ICT_Bot.mq5 with the complete MQL5 EA implementation
Implement input parameters matching Python config: Symbol=US100, RiskPercent=1%, MaxDailyLoss=3%, SwingLookback=5, EqualLevelTolerance=5, MinSweepPips=2, MaxBufferSize=500

Implement Kill Zone time windows in ET (Eastern Time) with proper UTC offset handling: Asian 20:00-00:00, London 02:00-05:00, NY AM 10:00-11:00, NY PM 13:30-16:00. Must handle crosses_midnight for Asian session.

Implement swing point detection identical to market_structure.py detect_swing_points(): a swing high has its high strictly greater than all surrounding lookback candles on each side; swing low has its low strictly less than all surrounding lookback candles on each side.

Implement MSS detection identical to market_structure.py detect_mss(): bullish MSS when close > swing_high that was LOWER than previous swing_high (lower highs pattern); bearish MSS when close < swing_low that was HIGHER than previous swing_low (higher lows pattern).

Implement equal level detection identical to liquidity.py _group_equal_levels() and detect_equal_levels(): group highs/lows within tolerance_pips of each other, requiring at least 2 touches per group.

Implement liquidity sweep detection identical to liquidity.py detect_liquidity_sweep(): sweep_high when high > level + min_sweep_pips AND close < level; sweep_low when low < level - min_sweep_pips AND close > level. Only detect first sweep per level.
Implement FVG detection identical to fvg.py detect_fvg(): bullish FVG when candle[i-2].high < candle[i].low; bearish FVG when candle[i-2].low > candle[i].high. Track midpoint = (high + low) / 2.

Implement iFVG detection identical to fvg.py detect_ifvg(): bullish FVG filled when subsequent low <= fvg_low becomes bearish_ifvg; bearish FVG filled when subsequent high >= fvg_high becomes bullish_ifvg.

Implement order block detection identical to order_blocks.py find_order_blocks(): bullish OB = last bearish candle (close < open) before bullish structure event; bearish OB = last bullish candle (close > open) before bearish structure event.
Implement OTE zone calculation identical to ote.py: bullish OTE zone = [swing_low + (1-0.79)*range, swing_low + (1-0.62)*range]; bearish OTE zone = [swing_low + 0.62*range, swing_low + 0.79*range].
Implement premium/discount filter identical to premium_discount.py: equilibrium = (swing_high + swing_low) / 2; reject long if entry_price > equilibrium; reject short if entry_price < equilibrium.

Implement the sequential state machine identical to entry_model.py EntryModel: states WAITING_FOR_SWEEP -> WAITING_FOR_MSS -> WAITING_FOR_FVG -> READY_TO_ENTER. Each candle advances the state machine. Buffer capped at MaxBufferSize (500). Reset on kill zone exit or after entry signal.

Implement state transitions: (1) WAITING_FOR_SWEEP: need >= 10 candles, detect equal levels then sweeps, take most recent sweep. (2) WAITING_FOR_MSS: need >= lookback*2+1 candles, detect swing points then MSS after sweep_index, validate direction alignment (sweep_high -> bearish_mss, sweep_low -> bullish_mss). (3) WAITING_FOR_FVG: detect FVGs at or after mss_break_index of the expected type, select highest bearish FVG (max by high) or lowest bullish FVG (min by low).

Implement entry signal generation: direction from MSS type (bearish_mss -> short, bullish_mss -> long). Entry price = FVG midpoint (limit order). SL for short = high of FVG candle + 1.0; SL for long = low of FVG candle - 1.0. TP = opposing swing high/low (most recent).
Implement HTF bias using Daily timeframe: at start of each day, fetch 20 D1 candles, detect swing points (lookback=2), set HTF range from max swing_high and min swing_low for premium/discount filter.

Implement position sizing identical to risk_management.py: risk_amount = balance * risk_percent; volume = risk_amount / (sl_distance * contract_size); round to volume_step; clamp to volume_min/volume_max. Skip trade if volume < volume_min.
Implement daily loss tracking: reset daily_pnl at start of each new day; check if abs(min(daily_pnl, 0)) >= balance * max_daily_loss before allowing new entries.
Implement trade execution: place BUY_LIMIT or SELL_LIMIT order at entry_price with SL and TP. Use ORDER_TIME_GTC. Comment format: 'ICT_<kill_zone_name>'.
Implement trade exit simulation for Strategy Tester: SL-first priority when both SL and TP hit in same candle (conservative approach matching Python backtester _check_trade_exit).
Add OTE confluence check (non-blocking): if entry_price is within OTE zone of recent swing range, flag as confluence but do not reject trade if outside.
Add Order Block confluence check (non-blocking): if entry_price falls within an unmitigated OB zone aligned with direction, flag as confluence.
Implement OnInit() to validate symbol, set up timer for 1-minute polling, initialize all buffers and state variables.
Implement OnTick() or OnTimer() as the main loop: check kill zone, check daily loss limit, feed new 1m candle to state machine, handle entry signals.
Implement OnDeinit() for cleanup.
Add comprehensive comments documenting the correspondence between each MQL5 function and its Python equivalent.
acceptance_criteria: All input parameters match Python config defaults: RiskPercent=0.01, MaxDailyLoss=0.03, SwingLookback=5, EqualLevelTolerance=5, MinSweepPips=2, MaxBufferSize=500
Kill zone time logic handles all 4 sessions including midnight crossing for Asian
Sequential state machine has identical state transitions as Python EntryModel
FVG detection uses identical 3-candle pattern logic with midpoint calculation
MSS detection uses identical swing-against-trend logic
Liquidity sweep detection uses identical sweep_high/sweep_low conditions
Position sizing formula is identical: volume = (balance * risk_percent) / (sl_distance * contract_size)
Entry is via limit order (BUY_LIMIT/SELL_LIMIT) at FVG midpoint
SL placement is at high/low of FVG candle +/- 1.0 point
TP placement targets opposing swing liquidity
Premium/discount filter rejects longs above equilibrium and shorts below equilibrium
Daily loss limit prevents trading when 3% daily loss is reached
HTF bias is derived from 20 D1 candles using swing detection with lookback=2
The file is valid MQL5 syntax that would compile in MetaEditor
verification: Verify ICT_Bot.mq5 exists at the repository root
Read the file and confirm it contains all required input parameters
Verify the state machine enum and transitions match Python exactly
Verify kill zone time handling matches all 4 sessions
Verify FVG, MSS, liquidity sweep logic matches Python algorithms
Verify position sizing formula matches Python
Verify file uses proper MQL5 syntax (property declarations, #property directives, proper types)
findings: MQL5 EA created at ICT_Bot.mq5 (1709 lines). Review fixes applied: (1) Added ServerUTCOffset input (default 0) for broker time correction while preserving identical default behavior to Python. (2) Added bounds checking after buffer trimming to reset state when indices go negative, matching Python rescan-from-scratch behavior. (3) Added CancelPendingOrders() on state machine reset to prevent stale limit orders, aligning with Python immediate-activation model. (4) Removed dead-code et_total < 0 check in Asian kill zone with documentation. All braces balanced. No compilation available but syntax validated.
